evals.prompt: Review our retirement planning flow for people with memory or attention difficulties.
evals.expected_output: Findings referencing W3C cognitive patterns or WCAG criteria, with severity and recommendations, plus copy rewrites where language is the issue.
expectations: Findings reference W3C cognitive guidance or WCAG criteria such as 3.3.7 or 3.3.8
Does not recommend removing legally required disclosures
Recommends testing with people with cognitive disabilities
